Class NetBlock

java.lang.Object
pl.AWTGameEngine.objects.net.NetBlock
public class NetBlock extends Object
NetBlock is used as a frame to transport data through the network.
Structure is simple: IDENTIFIER;COMPONENT;DATA
Where:
IDENTIFIER is GameObject's identifier,
COMPONENT is component's name (/w package),
DATA is data which is being sent
╚ is a standard delimiter for data, which allows to send more than one information to component - use method formData(Object...) to add delimiters
